acceptance: inverts exact round-trip colors (#000000, #ffffff, COLOR_PALETTE.black): given Dark-mode filtered hex values of #000000 (#ededed), #ffffff (#121212), and COLOR_PALETTE.black (#d3d3d3), expect invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(c)) returns the exact original hex string c

preserves alpha channel, respects enable=false, and clamps out-of-range pixels to nearest colour: given Semi-transparent/transparent dark-mode colours, enable=false input, and out-of-range raw pixels #000000 and #ffffff, expect Preserves alpha suffix, returns input unchanged when enable is false, and for raw pixels #000000 and #ffffff returns a 7-character hex whose applyDarkModeFilter output is at least as close (squared RGB distance) to the pixel as applyDarkModeFilter('#ffffff') resp. applyDarkModeFilter('#000000')
